after: $10Xiaoyao! Xiaoyao!~30
"With sword, I roam the world;"
"With wine, I laugh at care."
"A thousand cups cannot fell me;"
"I am the Drunken Sword Immortal."
Kid sings:
Lu Dongbin rides the wind,
A dragon sword on his back.
He slays demons, saves the weak;
His name endures through time.
Han Xiangzi plays a jade flute,
Leaving home to seek the Way.
Snow stopped Han Yu at Blue Pass;
He raised him to the heavens.
Kid sings:
Cao Guojiu loves his freedom,
Casting off his robe of rank.
Of all the paths, he chose the Way,
Clapping his immortal tablets.
Li Tieguai, fierce and loud,
Dark face, thick brows, a lame leg.
He seeks eternal life with faith,
And rides the clouds on his crutch.
Kid sings:
Han Zhongli, so proud of spirit,
Saw through all the worldly ways.
He sought the Way on Zhongnan,
And rose among the immortals.
He Xiangu, so fair and gentle,
Left this world to seek quiet.
Through long years she sought truth,
And found freedom in the heavens.
Kid sings:
Young Lan Caihe loves the Way,
Rich in spirit, free from care.
On sacred peaks the truth was won;
A basket carries them over seas.
Old Zhang Guolao, white of hair,
His temples frosted with age.
He laughs astride a backward mule,
Leaving worldly splendor behind.

after: Lin Tiannan:
Enough. Let us stop arguing.

before: 想不到无双美质今双遇，
分明是第一佳人第一仙。
为何的冒雨冲风到此间？
after: Xu Xian:
Two peerless beauties meet today,
One a maiden, one a fairy.
Ladies, please tell me your names.
Where do you come from?
Why brave this wind and rain?

before: 乍闻此言暗含笑，半是欢喜半羞惭
定睛把那许仙看，目秀眉清非等闲
after: Lady Bai:
His words bring joy and shy delight.
I look at him with a secret smile.
Such fine eyes and noble features!
Chorus:
A bond from a former life unites them.
Fate joins lovers across a thousand miles.
Xiao Qing:
My lady!
This gentleman has asked your name.
Why meet his gaze without a word?
Lady Bai:
I live in Black Bamboo Lane, Hangzhou.
My surname is Bai; I am eighteen.
My ancestors came from Yunnan.
Now I make my home in Hangzhou.

before: 敝人也在城南住，姓许名仙家业寒
今日游湖归来晚，偏遇天气雨连绵
after: Xu Xian:
I am Xu Xian, from a poor family
in the south of the city.
Returning from the lake so late,
I met this endless rain.
Lady Bai:
My small shoes make walking hard.
This frail body can bear no more.
Xu Xian:
I would gladly travel with you.
Seeing you home will ease my mind.
Xiao Qing:
My lady!
This scholar is boldly smitten.
His words are so amusing!
Please do not let this chance slip by.
Be lovers like Wen Xiao and Cailuan.

before: 还要试探他真心虔不虔，
after: Lady Bai:
He surely has a loving heart,
Yet I must test how true it is.
We must keep our true selves hidden.
Do not reveal our secret arts.
Xiao Qing:
My lady, what shall we do?
Lady Bai:
Borrow his umbrella for our way home.
Ask him to fetch it in two days.
Then I shall work my hidden arts;
My magic can reach the heavens.

before: 就是那八洞神仙要脱逃难
岂不是人间天上无双美
after: Xiao Qing:
He cannot escape this spell of love!
Even the Eight Immortals would fail.
A peerless beauty on earth or in heaven,
A fated love in a golden house.

before: 人间天上无双美呀无双美，

after: Chorus:
Peerless beauty in heaven and on earth!
